equity_weekly.prediction_horizon: 7 calendar days, settled on the configured next eligible exchange observation
equity_weekly.observation_unit: one immutable pre-issued symbol prediction with a horizon-matched corporate-action-adjusted outcome
equity_weekly.positive_forecast_definition: predicted adjusted return is greater than zero
equity_weekly.hit_definition: predicted direction equals the sign of the 7-day adjusted return
equity_weekly.top_decile_definition: top 10 percent of pre-issued scores evaluated only on the untouched chronological test
equity_weekly.benchmark: same-horizon NIFTY broad-market adjusted return fixed at issue time

current.note: Retrospective replay selections are not forward-issued OOS predictions.

cepe_next_open.instrument: exact dated NSE F&O option contract (symbol, expiry, strike, CE/PE)
cepe_next_open.prediction_horizon: prior session close observation to next session opening observation
cepe_next_open.observation_unit: one immutable pre-issued contract prediction with an exact-identity next-open outcome
cepe_next_open.positive_forecast_definition: pre-issued candidate whose registered target is next-open gross multiple >=3x
cepe_next_open.hit_definition: exact contract next-open/prior-close gross reference multiple reaches the registered threshold
cepe_next_open.top_decile_definition: top 10 percent of pre-issued scores evaluated only on the untouched chronological test
cepe_next_open.benchmark: eligible full matched-contract-set >=3x base rate for the same session pair
cepe_next_open.execution_warning: The next opening observation is not an executable fill; cost-adjusted performance requires dated fees and slippage.

current.note: Cached retrospective winners and baseline selections are not independently timestamped forward forecasts.
